title: Scalar evaluation from normalized counits
statement: Given permitted rational Hom predicates over E and L, counit maps eE and eL, and hypotheses identifying each with normalizedCounit, the recorded rational tensor and Hom scalar comparisons satisfy the finite scalar evaluation square for every K,M over E.

proof.text: For any partial closed structure, parameter naturality of transpose identifies the inverse transpose of f with tensor(f, identity) followed by evaluation. Prove this elementary identity privately using injectivity of transpose and its inverse identities.

Apply rationalHomScalar_transpose to evaluation at the permitted pair (K,M). Evaluation transposes to the identity, so the scalar-extended evaluation transposes to the Hom scalar comparison. Apply inverse transpose and the preceding identity to obtain the scalar evaluation equation with Hom as the first tensor factor.

Rewrite the supplied counits using their normalization hypotheses. Naturality of the rational signed tensor braiding moves the Hom scalar comparison through the braiding. Substitute the Hom-first evaluation equation, use the scalar-braiding compatibility clause of rationalHomScalar_transpose, and finish with associativity and functoriality.

theorem scalarEvaluation_of_normalizedCounits
    (hE : ∀ K M : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X,
      constructibleRationalHomPairs l E X (op K, M))
    (hL : ∀ K M : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l L X,
      constructibleRationalHomPairs l L X (op K, M))
    (eE : ∀ K M : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X,
      (RationalVerdier.tensor D l hl X E).obj
          (K, (homRight l E X hE K).obj M) ⟶ M)
    (eL : ∀ K M : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l L X,
      (RationalVerdier.tensor D l hl X L).obj
          (K, (homRight l L X hL K).obj M) ⟶ M)
    (heE : ∀ K M, eE K M = normalizedCounit D l hl X E hE K M)
    (heL : ∀ K M, eL K M = normalizedCounit D l hl X L hL K M) :
    ∀ K M : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X,
      (RationalVerdier.tensor D l hl X L).map
          (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 ((RationalVerdier.scalar l X E L ι).obj K))
            (rationalHomScalarComparison l E L ι X
              ⟨(op K, M), hE K M⟩).hom) ≫ eL
          ((RationalVerdier.scalar l X E L ι).obj K)
          ((RationalVerdier.scalar l X E L ι).obj M) =
        (@rationalTensorScalarComparison l _ E _ _ _ L _ _ _ ι X
          (RationalVerdier.units D l hl X)).inv.app
            (K, (homRight l E X hE K).obj M) ≫
          (RationalVerdier.scalar l X E L ι).map (eE K M)
